professionalSummary: Search quality analyst on a knowledge search product for three years, measuring search quality through the relevance judgement programme under the team's measurement standard with monthly judgement batches. (src_bacb9c2b5d2c)
experienceHighlights: Analysed the query logs for failure patterns each week and prepared the weekly quality report for the search product manager, with the reports filed in the search quality folder. (src_a770d6135f2d)
Proposed nineteen ranking rule changes with their expected effect on the quality metrics; each was approved or declined by the search product manager, recorded on the proposal. (src_dbaa31fed503)
Coordinated the judgement batches with the six relevance judges through the batch schedule, recording which batch designs were mine and which followed the standard templates. (src_c142dee9f8a3)
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each ranking rule proposal for the ranking engineers. (src_55fb49d073a9)
